pages.text: $(o)The last entry the Order was able to write.$()$(br2)The Portal cannot be opened. Not by choice, but for want of material:$(br)the seal on the great Gate is finished, but the stone that must hold it$(br)is not where we set it.$(br2)The Warden kept watch over the gap, not over the gate.$(br)That is why nothing would hold.$(br2)$(o)Whoever reads this: the Order's stone is stored underground.$(br)Find it. And read the appendix first.$()
